music_profile.musical_form: A mixture of Betawi, Javanese, and Sundanese styles

music_profile.sound_description: A rhythmic blend of traditional Betawi frame drums (rebana) with Javanese and Sundanese melodic influences, characterized by a call-and-response feel between singers and percussion.
music_profile.vocal_style: Singing featuring the repetitive phrase 'ya, ya, ya'
